mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the monthly CPIAUCSL inflation index above 3% for two consecutive months signals central bank over-tightening, which raises real discount rates and compresses equity present-value forecasts, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL crosses above 3.0 and remains above 3.0 for two consecutive months
regime_hint: accelerating inflation in a tightening cycle
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not statistically different from zero during inflation spikes (p > 0.10), or CPIAUCSL reverts below 3.0 within one month.

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS rises by more than 0.25 percentage points in a single month, the expected discount rate for equities increases, lowering the present value of future earnings and pushing S&P 500 forward returns negative over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in >70% of such FEDFUNDS moves (t-test p < 0.05), or the effect is absent in post-peak normalization periods.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly rise in PAYEMS (labor market additions) of at least 20,000 jobs over three months indicates a strengthening labor market, which raises consumer confidence and corporate earnings expectations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not statistically positive (p > 0.10) during the identified labor expansion, or the effect persists only in non-crisis periods.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp monthly decline in INDPRO (industrial production index) of at least 5 points signals supply-side weakness that reduces earnings growth expectations, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.10) during confirmed contraction months, or INDPRO rebounds within one month.

mechanism_narrative: When HOUST (household spending in thousands of units) rises by at least 10% month-over-month for two consecutive months, it indicates accelerating consumer demand, which elevates earnings expectations and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST month-over-month % change > +10% for two consecutive months
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not statistically positive (p > 0.10) during such demand spikes, or the effect is absent in high-inflation regimes.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in both RSAFS (retail sales) and UNRATE (unemployment) by at least 2% and 0.5 percentage points respectively over a month signals a dual shock: falling consumption and tighter labor markets, which together depress equity valuations and produce negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS monthly % change < -2% AND UNRATE monthly % change < -0.5%
regime_hint: co-occurring demand and labor market shocks
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not negative in >80% of such dual-shock events (p < 0.05), or either variable reverts individually before the return window.

mechanism_narrative: Persistent upward trend in GDPC1 (GDP chainless) over the past 12 months is associated with stronger economic momentum that elevates equity valuation multiples, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not statistically positive (p > 0.10) during periods of confirmed GDP trend, or the effect is absent in recessions as defined by NBER.

mechanism_narrative: During a post-crisis recovery regime (as defined by low inflation and rising employment), a rise in UNRATE above 5% for two consecutive months is associated with a pause in wage growth, which reduces earnings growth forecasts and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE monthly average over 2 months > +5% AND regime: post-crisis recovery
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not negative during qualifying UNRATE spikes (p > 0.10), or the regime condition is not met.
